## About
Fender Works is a full service auto body repair and refinishing shop in Clearwater, Florida. Dents, bumpers, paint, frames, headlights: bring it in and we'll take a look.
We keep it honest and down to earth. We'll beat any written estimate, and we won't lose a job over price. Reviewers mention Adam and his team by name, and we're rated 5 stars from 49 Google reviews.

## Services
- Free Estimates: Stop by and we'll look over the damage and give you an estimate at no charge.
- Free Towing to Auto Body Shop Clearwater area: Can't drive it in? We'll tow it to the shop for free in the Clearwater area.
- Bumper Repair: Front and rear bumpers repaired and repainted. One reviewer had both done on a BMW.
- Frame Repair: Frame work after a collision, so the car sits and drives right again.
- Paint Restoration: Bring tired or damaged paint back to a clean finish.
- Headlight Restoration: Clear up cloudy, yellowed headlights.
- Wet Sand/ Buffing: Buff out scratches and swirl marks. One reviewer said it made their front bumper look so much better.
- Replacement Parts: When a part can't be saved, we'll replace it.

## FAQ
Q: Do you charge for estimates?
A: No. Estimates are free.

Q: What if I already have a quote from another shop?
A: Bring it in. We'll beat any written estimate.

Q: Do your repairs come with a warranty?
A: Yes. All of our repairs come with a lifetime warranty.

Q: Can I drop off my car after hours?
A: Call and leave a voicemail. We check it periodically after hours for tow deliveries and drop-offs.
